evidence_scope: predictor availability on frozen global coastal geometry

figure_captions.fig01_minimum_global_coverage.png: Figure 1. Minimum monthly area-weighted availability on the frozen 400-km global coastal mask during 1993-2025; dashed thresholds define the pre-registered deployment classes.
figure_captions.fig02_monthly_global_coverage.png: Figure 2. Monthly area-weighted availability for the five standardized dynamic predictors across the frozen product geometry from January 1993 through December 2025.
figure_captions.fig03_time_block_minima.png: Figure 3. Worst monthly product-area availability within the four frozen temporal blocks, exposing source-era weaknesses that a whole-period mean would conceal.
figure_captions.fig04_shelf_vs_product.png: Figure 4. Mean availability over the complete coastal product and the GEBCO 0-200 m shelf core, quantifying whether missingness intensifies near the shallow coast.
figure_captions.fig05_latitude_minima.png: Figure 5. Minimum monthly area-weighted availability by ten-degree latitude band, identifying polar and regional holes inside the global product envelope.
figure_captions.fig06_spatial_minimum_fraction.png: Figure 6. Exact fraction of 1993-2025 months in which all five standardized predictors are simultaneously valid at each coastal node.
figure_captions.fig07_socat_row_availability.png: Figure 7. Predictor availability at frozen SOCAT SSS and fCO2 grid-month rows inside the new product mask; target values select audit rows but never enter predictor construction.
figure_captions.fig08_inventory_classification.png: Figure 8. Final readiness classification across measured, static, deterministic, derived, and currently absent predictor groups under the frozen Issue 52 rules.
figure_captions.fig09_source_timeline.png: Figure 9. Nominal source coverage against the 1993-2025 core period; chlorophyll-a is structurally absent before mid-2002 and after 2020 even if its raw source is restored.
figure_captions.fig10_repair_priority.png: Figure 10. Engineering priority matrix combining expected scientific value and current readiness; point size encodes urgency for the next predictor-cube issue.
figure_captions.fig11_joint_monthly_coverage.png: Figure 11. Exact monthly area where SST, GLORYS SSS, ADT, wind speed, and atmospheric xCO2 are all valid together, shown for the full coastal product and shelf core.
